SELECT l.id, l.trace_id AS traceId, l.app_id AS appId, a.app_name AS appName, l.module, l.operation_type AS operationType, l.description, l.operator_username AS operatorUsername, l.request_method AS requestMethod, l.request_url AS requestUrl, l.request_params AS requestParams, l.response_result AS responseResult, l.ip_address AS ipAddress, l.status, l.error_message AS errorMessage, l.duration_ms AS durationMs, l.operated_at AS operatedAt FROM sys_operation_log l LEFT JOIN sys_app a ON a.app_id = l.app_id AND a.deleted = 0
ORDER BY l.operated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT l.app_id AS appId, a.app_name AS appName, l.module, l.operation_type, l.description, l.operator_username, l.request_url, l.request_params, l.response_result, l.ip_address, l.status, l.error_message, l.duration_ms, l.operated_at FROM sys_operation_log l LEFT JOIN sys_app a ON a.app_id = l.app_id AND a.deleted = 0
ORDER BY l.operated_at DESC LIMIT 10000
